headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: SAI (5)

summary: Lando Norris won the Singapore Grand Prix from pole position, 20.9s ahead of Max Verstappen, with Oscar Piastri completing the podium.
Guanyu Zhou made the biggest climb, from P20 to P15.
Kevin Magnussen had a day to forget, dropping from P14 to P19.
There were 23 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 52 points over Lando Norris.
